reading: しつれいします
note: Said entering or leaving a meeting room or a boss's office.

term: すみません。いま手が離せないんです。
reading: すみませんいまてがはなせないんです
back: Sorry, I'm tied up right now.
note: When a colleague interrupts and you can't stop what you're doing.

reading: おつかれさまでした
note: The usual reply to お先に失礼します, or at the end of a meeting or shift.

term: お世話になっております。
reading: おせわになっております
note: Stock opener for business emails and calls to clients. Not meant literally.

reading: しょうちしました
note: Accepting an instruction from a boss or client. Safer than 了解です upward.

reading: りょうかいです
note: Quick reply to peers in chat. Some bosses find it too casual from juniors.

reading: ちょっといいですか
note: Catching a colleague or your boss at their desk before asking something.

reading: ちょっとおくれます
note: Quick message to your team or a meeting when you're running behind.

reading: かくにんしておきます
back: I'll check and get back to you.
note: Buying time when you don't know the answer yet. Very common.

term: ご確認よろしくお願いします。
reading: ごかくにんよろしくおねがいします
note: Closing line when you send a file or draft for someone to review.

reading: かいぎはなんじから
note: Asking a coworker you're close to. Add ですか for a senior.

term: 締め切りはいつですか？
reading: しめきりはいつですか
note: Asking when a task or document is due.

reading: しんちょくどうですか
note: A manager checking on your work. Classic, slightly dreaded office line.

term: 資料、メールで送っておきますね。
reading: しりょうメールでおくっておきますね
note: Offering to send slides or handouts after a meeting.

term: 熱があるので今日は休みます。
reading: ねつがあるのできょうはやすみます
back: I've got a fever, so I'm taking today off.
note: Calling or messaging in sick in the morning.

reading: きょうはざいたくです
note: Telling the team where you are. 在宅 = 在宅勤務.

term: 今日は定時で帰ります。
reading: きょうはていじでかえります
note: Heads-up that you won't stay late, e.g. for plans after work.

term: 来週、有給取ってもいいですか？
reading: らいしゅうゆうきゅうとってもいいですか
back: Can I take a day off next week?
note: Asking your boss for paid leave. 有給 = paid holiday.

term: これ、お願いしてもいいですか？
reading: これおねがいしてもいいですか
back: Could I ask you to handle this?
note: Handing a small task to a colleague politely.

term: 何か手伝えることある？
reading: なにかてつだえることある
note: Offering help to a busy coworker you're on casual terms with.

reading: おひるいっしょにたべない
note: Inviting a coworker to lunch.

reading: きょうもざんぎょうだよ
note: Grumbling to a friend or partner about overtime.

reading: あたらしいしごとはどう
note: Asking a friend who just changed jobs.

reading: にゅうしゃしてなんねんめ
back: How many years have you been here?
note: Small talk with a coworker; seniority matters, so people ask early.

reading: らいしゅうしゅっちょうなんだ
back: I'm away on a business trip next week.
note: Telling friends or family about a work trip.

reading: あしためんせつなんだ
back: I have a job interview tomorrow.
note: Telling a friend you're job hunting.

term: 明日からまた仕事だよ。
reading: あしたからまたしごとだよ
note: Sighed on the last evening of a holiday or weekend.

reading: しごといきたくない
back: I don't want to go to work.
note: Monday-morning moan to family or friends.

reading: あしたはきゅうりょうびだ
note: Happy remark to yourself or friends.

term: 上司にこっぴどく叱られた。
reading: じょうしにこっぴどくしかられた
back: My boss really chewed me out.
note: Venting to a friend after a bad day.

reading: てんしょくしようかな
note: Musing aloud to a friend when work is getting you down.

term: 本日の会議は中止になりました。
reading: ほんじつのかいぎはちゅうしになりました
note: Announcement you'll get by email or from an organizer.
